text:
Phan 10: Bieu do Tuong tac, Sequence Diagram & Dynamic Modeling - Chu
de 10
Trong phan 10 cua buoi hoc thu tu nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve Mo hinh dong (Dynamic
Modeling) thong qua Bieu do Tuong tac (Interaction Diagrams), bao gom Sequence Diagram (Bieu do Trinh
tu) de mo ta thong diep theo thoi gian, Communication Diagram (Bieu do Giao tiep) va cac cau truc dieu
kien, vong lap (alt, loop, opt) trong thiet ke phan mem huong doi tuong.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Thiet ke Chuyen sâu:
- Sequence Diagram Internals: Bieu dien cac doi tuong tham gia, duong doi (lifelines), thong diep dong b■
(synchronous calls), bat dong bo (asynchronous) va su tra ve (return values) theo truc thoi gian doc.
- Combined Fragments: Su dung cac khung dieu kien (alt), vong lap (loop), lua chon (opt) va tham chieu
(ref) de xu ly logic phuc tap trong cac kich b■n nghiep vu.
- Communication Diagram: Tap trung vao moi quan he lien ket cau truc va thu tu thong diep giua cac doi
tuong thay vi truc thoi gian.
2. Mau Thiet ke Sequence & Interaction Specification (Phan 10):
Sequence Diagram Interaction Specification - Module 10
Architect: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Sequence Interaction Flow for Module 10
Client -> OrderController_10: submitOrder(orderDTO)
OrderController_10 -> OrderService_10: processOrder(orderDTO)
OrderService_10 -> InventoryService_10: checkStock()
alt Stock Available
InventoryService_10 --> OrderService_10: true
OrderService_10 -> PaymentGateway_10: chargePayment()
PaymentGateway_10 --> OrderService_10: success
else Out of Stock
InventoryService_10 --> OrderService_10: false
OrderService_10 --> OrderController_10: throw InsufficientStockException
end
3. Bai tap thuc hanh & Thao luan nhom:
- Xay dung Sequence Diagram chi tiet cho chuc nang xu ly dat hang va thanh toan trong module 10.
- Thao luan ve cach su dung combined fragments (alt/loop) de the hien cac nhanh re nhanh nghiep vu
trong phan 10.

hoat (vi du: Adapter chuyen doi giao dien, Decorator bo sung tinh nang dong).
- Behavioral Patterns: Giai quyet su phan bo trach nhiem va thu tuc giao tiep giua cac doi tuong (vi du:
Observer thong bao trang thai, Strategy dong goi thuat toan).

courseTitle: Phương pháp phát triển phần mềm hướng đối tượng-2-25
sessionTitle: BUOI 9: Object-Oriented Project Deployment, Maintenance & Course Summary (Buoi cuoi
text:
Phan 20: Trien khai Du an, Bao tri & Tong ket Hoc phan - Chu de 20
Trong phan 20 cua buoi hoc tong ket cuoi cung nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve quy trinh trien khai
phan mem huong doi tuong len moi truong production (Deployment Strategies), dong goi ung dung voi
Docker, quan ly cau hinh he thong, bao tri phan mem va tong ket toan bo kien thuc cot lõi cua hoc phan
Phuong phap phat trien phan mem huong doi tuong.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Quan tri Chuyen sâu:
- Deployment & Containerization: Dong goi ung dung huong doi tuong vao Docker containers va thiet lap
CI/CD pipelines de tu dong hoa qua trinh build va deploy.
- Software Maintenance & Refactoring: Cac ky thuat tai cau truc ma nguon (Refactoring Smells) de duy trì
tinh clean code va mo rong he thong trong dai han.
- Course Summary: Tong hop toan bo tu UML modeling, Design Patterns, Layered/Clean Architecture cho
den Unit Testing va TDD.
2. Mau Dockerfile & Deployment Script (Phan 20):
Object-Oriented Project Deployment & Docker Specification - Module 20
Architect: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Multi-stage Dockerfile for Enterprise OOP Application (Module 20)
FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jdk-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN ./mvnw clean package -DskipTests
FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/target/enterprise-app-20.jar app.jar
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "app.jar"]
3. Bai tap thuc hanh & Thao luan nhom:
- Xay dung Dockerfile va cau hinh Docker Compose de trien khai ung dung huong doi tuong kem
PostgreSQL cho module 20.
- Tong ket do an mon hoc va trinh bày kien truc tong the cua he thong phan mem trong phan 20.
Mon hoc: PP PT Phin mem huong doi tuong — Buoi 9 (Project Deployment & Course Summary)
Tai lieu dao tao chuyen sau PP PT PM huong doi tuong Trang 20 / 20

courseTitle: Quản lý dự án CNTT-2-25
sessionTitle: BUOI 1: Tong quan Quan ly du an CNTT, Khoi dong & Xay dung Project Charter
text:
Phan 20: Nen tang Ly thuyet & Thuc tien Quan ly Du an CNTT - Chu de
20
Trong phan 20 cua buoi hoc nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau cac khia canh quan ly du an cong nghe
thong tin theo chuan PMBOK, phan tich chi tiet cac quy trình khoi dong, lap ke ho■ch, thuc thi, kiem soat va
dong du an phan mem doanh nghiep.
1. Phan tich Chuyen sau va Mohinh Quan ly:
- Quan ly Pham vi (Scope Management): Xac dinh ro cac yeu cau chuc nang va phi chuc nang, kiem soat
hien tuong phinh pham vi (Scope Creep).
- Quan ly Thoi gian & Tien do (Schedule Management): Ap dung phuong phap Duong gang (Critical Path
Method - CPM) va bieu do Gantt.
- Quan ly Chi phí & Ngan sach (Cost Management): Du toan chi phí nhân su, ha tang cloud, quan ly dong
tien du an.
2. Mau Tai lieu & Bieu mau Quan ly Du an (Phan 20):
Project: IT Infrastructure & Software Upgrade - Module 20
Manager: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
- Risk ID: RS-2001
- Risk Description: Potential delay in third-party API integration.
- Probability: Medium | Impact: High
- Mitigation Strategy: Implement mock services and fallback mechanisms early.
- Assigned Owner: Technical Lead (Part 20)
3. Bai tap tinh huong & Cau hoi thao luan nhom:
- Xay dung bang phan cong cong viec (WBS) chi tiet cho module 20 cua he thong e-commerce.
- Danh gia cac chi so Earned Value Management (EVM) nhu SPI, CPI cho giai ■o■n 20.
Mon hoc: Quan ly du an CNTT — Buoi 1 (Tong quan & Khoi dong du an)
Tai lieu dao tao chuyen sau Quan ly du an CNTT Trang 20 / 20

text:
Phan 17: Lap Ke hoach Tien do & CPM trong Du an CNTT - Chu de 17
Trong phan 17 cua buoi hoc thu ba nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve phuong phap xac dinh duong
gang (Critical Path Method - CPM), uoc tinh thoi gian cong viec (PERT), lap bieu do Gantt va quan ly tien do
thi cong phan mem trong moi truong doanh nghiep.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Chuyen sâu:
- Network Diagram & CPM: Xac dinh chuoi cac hoat ■■ng quyet dinh thoi gian hoan thanh toi thieu cua
toan bo du an, khong co do tre (Float = 0).
- PERT Estimation: Su dung cong thuc uoc tinh ba diem (Optimistic, Pessimistic, Most Likely) de tinh toan
ky vong thoi gian thuc te.
- Schedule Compression: Ap dung ky thuat Crashing (tang nguon luc) va Fast Tracking (lam song song)
khi can rut ngan tien do.

Trong phan 4 cua buoi hoc thu tu nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve phuong phap hoach ■inh nguon

- RACI Matrix: Phan dinh ro trach nhiem cua cac ben lien quan gom Responsible (Thuc hien), Accountable

- Cost Estimating Techniques: Su dung uoc tinh tuong tu (Analogous), uoc tinh tham so (Parametric) va
uoc tinh tu duoi len (Bottom-up) de dam bo do chinh xac.
- Resource Leveling & Smoothing: Giai quyet tinh trang qua tai nguon luc (Resource Overallocation) bang
cach dieu chinh thoi gian hoac tang nhan su hop ly.

text:
Phan 5: Quan ly User, Group & Phan quyen He thong - Chu de 5
Trong phan 5 cua buoi hoc thu hai nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve quan ly tai khoan nguoi dung
(useradd, usermod), phan quyen nhom (groupadd), cau hinh quyen sudo nang cao cho cac quan tri vien,
quan ly file /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow va ap dung nguyen tac dac quyen toi thieu (Principle of Least
Privilege) trong doanh nghiep.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Quan tri Chuyen sâu:
- User & Group Management: Tao, xoa, sua tai khoan, quan ly UID/GID, thiet lap mat khau het han
(chage) va quan ly thu muc goc (home directory).
- Sudoers Configuration: Cau hinh an toan file /etc/sudoers qua lenh visudo, phan quyen han che lenh cho
tung nhom nguoi dung cu the.
- Permission Audit: Su dung lenh find, chmod, chown de kiem tra va xu ly cac file co gan bit SUID/SGID
nguy hiem.
2. Mau Cau hinh Script & User Management Task (Phan 5):
User & Sudoers Management Script - Module 5
Administrator: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create a secure system user with non-login shell for Module 5
sudo useradd -m -s /bin/bash sysops_5
sudo passwd sysops_5
# 2. Add user to admin group and configure sudoers rule
sudo usermod -aG sudo sysops_5
echo "sysops_5 ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl restart nginx" | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.
d/sysops_5
3. Bai tap thuc hanh & Thao luan nhom:
- Xay dung kich ban tu dong tao danh sach 50 user cho phong ban ky thuat va phan quyen nhom cho
module 5.
- Kiem tra va tim kiem tat ca cac file mang quyen SUID tren toan bo he thong de dam bao an toan cho
phan 5.

sessionTitle: BUOI 3: Quan ly Dich vu Systemd, Network Configuration & IP Routing trong Linux
text:
Phan 3: Quan ly Dich vu Systemd & Cau hinh Mang Linux - Chu de 3
Trong phan 3 cua buoi hoc thu ba nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve he thong quan ly tien trinh
systemd, cach viet unit file tuy chinh cho cac ung dung doanh nghiep, cau hinh dia chi IP t■nh,
Netplan/NetworkManager, dinh tuyen mang (IP Routing), phan giai DNS va kiem tra ket noi mang nang cao
trong he thong Linux.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Quan tri Chuyen sâu:
- Systemd Service Management: Quan ly trang thai, khoi dong, tat va tu dong phuc hoi (Restart=always)
cho cac tien trinh nen thong qua systemctl va custom unit files.
- Network Configuration: Cau hinh dia chi IP tinh, gateway, DNS thong qua Netplan tren Ubuntu hoac
NetworkManager tren RHEL/CentOS.
- Routing & Troubleshooting: Su dung ip route, ss, netstat, tcpdump va traceroute de chan doan va xu ly
su co ket noi mang trong he thong phan tan.
2. Mau Cau hinh Systemd Service & Network Script (Phan 3):
Systemd Service & Network Configuration - Module 3
Administrator: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Custom Systemd Service File for Enterprise App (Module 3)
[Unit]
Description=Enterprise Java/Python Application Module 3
After=network.target postgresql.service
[Service]
Type=simple
User=sysops_3
ExecStart=/usr/bin/java -jar /opt/apps/app-3.jar
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
3. Bai tap thuc hanh & Thao luan nhom:
- Xay dung custom systemd service cho ung dung va cau hinh tu dong khoi dong cung he thong cho
module 3.
- Cau hinh giao dien mang t■nh va kiem tra bang dinh tuyen (routing table) tren server phan 3.
Mon hoc: Quan tri he thong — Buoi 3 (Quan ly Dich vu Systemd & Network Networking)
Tai lieu dao tao chuyen sau Quan tri he thong doanh nghiep Trang 3 / 20

sessionTitle: BUOI 4: Quan ly Luu tru Nang cao, LVM (Logical Volume Manager) & Filesystem
text:
Phan 16: Quan ly Luu tru, LVM & Filesystem trong Linux - Chu de 16
Trong phan 16 cua buoi hoc thu tu nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve he thong quan ly luu tru nang
cao tren Linux, su dung LVM (Logical Volume Manager) de tao Physical Volumes (PV), Volume Groups
(VG), Logical Volumes (LV), mo rong va thu h■p phan vung dong, dinh dang filesystem ext4/XFS, cau hinh
fstab va kiem tra sua loi dia cung.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Quan tri Chuyen sâu:
- LVM Architecture: Co che trtrung gian giua phan cung vat ly va he thong tep, cho phep linh hoat thay doi
kich thuoc phan vung ma khong mat du lieu.
- Volume Management Workflow: Tao PV tu o dia/phan vung, gom nhom vao VG va cat lat thanh cac LV
de su dung lam filesystem.
- Filesystem Maintenance: Su dung cac cong cu nhu fsck (cho ext4), xfs_repair, tune2fs va mount/umount
de quan ly o dia an toan.
2. Mau Cau hinh LVM & Filesystem Script (Phan 16):
LVM Setup & Storage Management Script - Module 16
Administrator: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create Physical Volume and Volume Group for Module 16
sudo pvcreate /dev/sdb1
sudo vgcreate vg_enterprise_16 /dev/sdb1
# 2. Create Logical Volume, Format ext4 and Mount
sudo lvcreate -L 20G -n lv_data_16 vg_enterprise_16
sudo mkfs.ext4 /dev/vg_enterprise_16/lv_data_16
sudo mkdir -p /mnt/data_16
sudo mount /dev/vg_enterprise_16/lv_data_16 /mnt/data_16
3. Bai tap thuc hanh & Thao luan nhom:
- Xay dung he thong LVM, tao volume group va mo rong kich thuoc Logical Volume khi day du lieu cho
module 16.
- Cau hinh tu dong mount o dia trong /etc/fstab su dung UUID de dam b■o an toan he thong phan 16.

Trong phan 11 cua buoi hoc thu tu nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve he thong quan ly luu tru nang
cao tren Linux, su dung LVM (Logical Volume Manager) de tao Physical Volumes (PV), Volume Groups
(VG), Logical Volumes (LV), mo rong va thu h■p phan vung dong, dinh dang filesystem ext4/XFS, cau hinh
fstab va kiem tra sua loi dia cung.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Quan tri Chuyen sâu:
- LVM Architecture: Co che trtrung gian giua phan cung vat ly va he thong tep, cho phep linh hoat thay doi
kich thuoc phan vung ma khong mat du lieu.
- Volume Management Workflow: Tao PV tu o dia/phan vung, gom nhom vao VG va cat lat thanh cac LV

- Filesystem Maintenance: Su dung cac cong cu nhu fsck (cho ext4), xfs_repair, tune2fs va mount/umount

LVM Setup & Storage Management Script - Module 11
Administrator: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create Physical Volume and Volume Group for Module 11
sudo pvcreate /dev/sdb1
sudo vgcreate vg_enterprise_11 /dev/sdb1
# 2. Create Logical Volume, Format ext4 and Mount
sudo lvcreate -L 20G -n lv_data_11 vg_enterprise_11
sudo mkfs.ext4 /dev/vg_enterprise_11/lv_data_11
sudo mkdir -p /mnt/data_11
sudo mount /dev/vg_enterprise_11/lv_data_11 /mnt/data_11

- Xay dung he thong LVM, tao volume group va mo rong kich thuoc Logical Volume khi day du lieu cho

text:
Phan 8: Quan ly Qua trinh & Tu dong hoa Tac vu trong Linux - Chu de 8
Trong phan 8 cua buoi hoc thu nam nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve quan ly qua trinh (Process
Management) tren Linux su dung ps, top, htop, kill, nice, renice, quan ly tien trinh nen voi nohup va screen,
cung nhu thiet lap lich trinh tu dong hoa tac vu voi cron, crontab va anacron cho he thong doanh nghiep.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Quan tri Chuyen sâu:
- Process Lifecycle & Signals: Quan ly vong doi tien trinh, gui tin hieu dieu khi■n (SIGTERM, SIGKILL,
SIGHUP) va theo doi PID/PPID.
- Process Priority & Resource Control: Dieu chinh do ■u tien (nice values tu -20 den 19) va phan bo tai
nguyen CPU cho cac tien trinh nang.
- Automated Task Scheduling: Cu phap crontab chuan (minute hour day month weekday) de tu dong thuc
thi script va backup dinh ky.
2. Mau Cau hinh Cronjob & Process Script (Phan 8):
Process Monitoring & Cron Automation Script - Module 8
Administrator: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Background execution with nohup for Module 8 task
nohup /usr/bin/python3 /opt/scripts/worker_8.py > /var/log/worker_8.log 2>&1 &
# 2. Crontab configuration for automated daily backup at 2:00 AM
0 2 * * * /bin/bash /opt/scripts/backup_8.sh >> /var/log/backup_8.log 2>&1
3. Bai tap thuc hanh & Thao luan nhom:
- Xay dung crontab job tu dong xoa file log cu va bao cao tai nguyen he thong cho module 8.
- Dieu chinh do uu tien (nice/renice) cho tien trinh xu ly du lieu nang de tranh anh huong den dich vu chinh
trong phan 8.

sessionTitle: BUOI 6: Quan ly Log (Log Rotation), System Monitoring & Performance Tuning
text:
Phan 5: Quan ly Log, Giam sat & Toi uu Hieu suat He thong - Chu de 5
Trong phan 5 cua buoi hoc thu sau nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve quan ly log he thong va ung
dung (Logrotate), phan tich file log voi journalctl va rsyslog, giam sat tai nguyen thoi gian thuc (Prometheus,
Grafana, Node Exporter) va toi uu hoa hieu suat kernel, CPU, Memory cho may chu doanh nghiep.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Quan tri Chuyen sâu:
- Log Management & Logrotate: Cau hinh tu dong xoay vong, nen va xoa log cu trong /etc/logrotate.d/ de
tiet kiem khong gian o dia.
- System Monitoring Tools: Su dung vmstat, iostat, sar, free va uptime de phat hien nghien co th■t
(bottlenecks) ve CPU, I/O hoac RAM.
- Kernel & Performance Tuning: Tinh chinh cac thong so sysctl.conf (vm.swappiness, fs.file-max,
net.core.somaxconn) de nang cao hieu nang mang va memory.
2. Mau Cau hinh Logrotate & Sysctl Tuning (Phan 5):
Logrotate & Performance Tuning Configuration - Module 5
Administrator: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Custom Logrotate Configuration for Enterprise App (Module 5)
/var/log/enterprise_5/*.log {
daily
rotate 14
compress
delaycompress
missingok
notifempty
create 640 root adm
}
# 2. Kernel Tuning in /etc/sysctl.conf
vm.swappiness = 10
fs.file-max = 2097152
3. Bai tap thuc hanh & Thao luan nhom:
- Thiet lap cau hinh logrotate cho ung dung tuy chinh va kiem tra hoat dong xoay vong log cho module 5.
- Phan tich chi so iostat va vmstat de tim ra nut that co chai ve o dia tren may chu phan 5.

sessionTitle: BUOI 7: Quan ly Backup, Restore Strategy & Disaster Recovery Planning
text:
Phan 4: Chien luoc Backup, Khoi phuc & Phuc hoi Tham hoa - Chu de 4
Trong phan 4 cua buoi hoc thu bay nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve chien luoc sao luu du lieu
doanh nghiep (Full, Incremental, Differential Backup), su dung cac cong cu tar, rsync, pg_dump,
mysqldump, xay dung quy trinh phuc hoi (Restore Strategy) va lap ke hoach phuc hoi sau tham hoa
(Disaster Recovery Plan - DRP) cho he thong ha tang phan tan.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Quan tri Chuyen sâu:
- Backup Strategies: Phan biet Full Backup (sao luu toan bo), Incremental Backup (sao luu phan thay doi
tu lan backup gan nhat) va Differential Backup (sao luu phan thay doi tu lan Full backup).
- Database Backup & Recovery: Thuc hien backup nong (hot backup) va lanh (cold backup) cho
PostgreSQL va MySQL dam bao tinh toan ven du lieu (ACID).
- Disaster Recovery Metrics: Xac dinh chi so RPO (Recovery Point Objective) va RTO (Recovery Time
Objective) de dam bao kha nang phuc hoi he thong khi xay ra su co nghiem trong.
2. Mau Cau hinh Backup & Restore Script (Phan 4):
Automated Backup & Disaster Recovery Script - Module 4
Administrator: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Automated PostgreSQL Database Backup Script for Module 4
BACKUP_DIR="/var/backups/postgresql_4"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%%Y%%m%%d_%%H%%M%%S")
mkdir -p $BACKUP_DIR
# Execute pg_dump with compression
pg_dump -U postgres -h localhost enterprise_db_4 | gzip > "$BACKUP_DIR/db_backup_$TIMESTAMP.s
ql.gz"
# 2. Retain only last 7 days of backups
find $BACKUP_DIR -type f -mtime +7 -exec rm -f {} \;
3. Bai tap thuc hanh & Thao luan nhom:
- Xay dung kich ban sao luu tu dong (backup script) ket hop nen gzip va luu tru cho module 4.
- Thuc hanh quy trinh khoi phuc du lieu (restore) tu file backup da nen cho co so du lieu trong phan 4.

sessionTitle: BUOI 9: Security Hardening, Incident Response & Ha tang Production (Buoi cuoi
text:
Phan 5: Security Hardening, X■ lý Su co & Tong ket Ha tang He thong -
Chu de 5
Trong phan 5 cua buoi hoc tong ket cuoi cung nay, chung ta nghien cuu chuyen sau ve quy trinh tang cuong
bao mat he thong (Security Hardening), cau hinh Fail2ban chong tan cong brute-force, quan ly chung chi
SSL/TLS voi Certbot, quy trinh xu ly su co bao mat (Incident Response) va van hanh ha tang production an
toan cho toan bo he thong doanh nghiep.
1. Ly thuyet va Phuong phap Quan tri Chuyen sâu:
- Linux Security Hardening: Tat cac dich vu khong can thiet, cau hinh SSH khong cho root login truc tiep,
su dung port khac va xac thuc khoa an toan.
- Intrusion Prevention (Fail2ban): Cau hinh jail cho SSH, Nginx va PostgreSQL de tu dong chan IP tan
cong brute-force.
- Incident Response & Auditing: Su dung auditd, fail2ban log, va nmap de kiem tra lo hong bao mat dinh ky
trong ha tang production.
2. Mau Cau hinh Security Hardening & Fail2ban (Phan 5):
Security Hardening & Fail2ban Configuration - Module 5
Administrator: Le Hong Son | Date: October 2026
------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Fail2ban Jail Configuration for SSH Protection (Module 5)
[sshd]
enabled = true
port = ssh
filter = sshd
logpath = /var/log/auth.log
maxretry = 3
bantime = 3600
# 2. Secure SSH Daemon Configuration (/etc/ssh/sshd_config)
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
X11Forwarding no
MaxAuthTries 3
3. Bai tap thuc hanh & Thao luan nhom:
- Cau hinh va kiem tra hoat dong cua Fail2ban de ngan chan tan cong brute-force tren may chu phan 5.
- Xay dung checklist kiem tra bao mat (Security Audit Checklist) truoc khi dua he thong vao moi truong
production trong phan 5.
